$comment: Five invented breaks for the demo, from the invented bank Meridian Trust Bank. The correspondent banks, accounts and entries do not exist. They follow the bank's records at the bank date 2026-11-24, so start the bank with BANK_TODAY=2026-11-24 for the desk and the bank to agree. Every date is written as a date. BRK-4001: a mistyped character in the reference, match. BRK-4002: one statement credit for two ledger entries of a batch, match. BRK-4003: a bank charge of 15.00, match with an adjusting entry. BRK-4004: a duplicate ledger posting, reverse the later entry. BRK-4005: nothing behind the item, refer to a person. Each case names only what the bank's reconciliation system holds.

cases.title: Aldoria Commerce Bank, statement credit USD 12,480.00
cases.text:
THE BREAK
Break: BRK-4001, open
Account: NOS-ALDB-01, Nostro account, USD, at Aldoria Commerce Bank
Opened: 19 Nov 2026, 5 days before the bank date of 24 Nov 2026

THE UNMATCHED ITEM
Entry: STM-8101, statement side
Amount: 12,480.00 USD, credit
Value date: 19 Nov 2026
Reference: INV-558210-AQ
Narrative: Incoming transfer, Corrowick Alloy Works

WHY IT IS HERE
Why: The statement item has no matched ledger entry.
Candidates listed: LED-7101, LED-7102

Everything here is as the reconciliation system holds it. The agent reads the break and its candidates itself from the reconciliation system.

Value date: 15 Nov 2026
Reference: UNK-77QX
Narrative: ADJ 77-QX NO REMITTANCE INFORMATION

WHY IT IS HERE
Why: The statement item has no matched ledger entry.
Candidates listed: none
The ledger and statement entries can be read and searched in the reconciliation system.
The break is older than 5 days. Under RECON-RULE-005 a break with no candidate that is older than 5 days is escalated the same day.

Everything here is as the reconciliation system holds it. The agent reads the break itself from the reconciliation system.
